verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents that TeamViewer has a Web API and an audit log/API, so issuing API credentials is a fair question for this product. However, no item mentions scoped tokens, permission scoping, or least-privilege credential issuance. Having an API is not the same as offering scoped credentials, and the community posts about saved client passwords concern a different subject.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
